render_target: Mobile Forward; baked/static lighting; no Nanite/Lumen requirement

authoring: Separate reusable wall, roof, stair and trim modules from unique landmarks; use ISM/HISM for repeated static modules with matching mesh/material.
Use static lighting/lightmaps and rough mobile material variants; keep windows opaque or masked only where silhouette requires it.
Create per-cell HLOD proxies for distant static, non-interactive clusters; keep doors, loot, destructibles and gameplay cover out of merges.
Use simple convex collision for movement; reserve complex collision for explicitly approved static traces.
gameplay_invariants: Preserve cover silhouette and line-of-sight semantics across device tiers.
Do not merge interactive or destructible actors into static HLOD.

authoring: Split deck, supports, rails and attached gameplay props so distant LODs can remove small structural detail without changing the deck silhouette.
Use separate simple collision volumes for the walkable deck, rails and supports; collision and navigation must remain independent of render LOD.
Use HLOD only for distant static scenery; retain a non-merged interactive/collision source for any traversable bridge.
Bake static illumination; avoid translucent glass and dynamic shadow casting on decorative underside details.
gameplay_invariants: Keep traversal width, height clearance, collision, navmesh connectivity and jump/fall edges identical across quality tiers.
Never simplify authoritative collision based solely on render LOD.

authoring: Use Static Mesh LODs for parked props and Skeletal Mesh LODs for moving/wheel-articulated vehicles; validate transition and silhouette from chase and combat cameras.
Reduce material slots and texture samples at distance; use a mobile master material with baked/static lighting assumptions and no expensive per-pixel effects.
Prioritize wheel hubs, suspension pivots and any gameplay-visible articulated section when generating skeletal LODs; remove non-functional interior detail at distance.
Use stable simple physics collision shapes independent of render LOD; use a static proxy/HLOD only for parked, non-interactive vehicles.
gameplay_invariants: Do not alter physics, collision, seat/interaction sockets, server authority, replication cadence or hitboxes in a rendering optimization.
Moving vehicles remain separate from static HLOD clusters.

validation_gates.source_audit: At least one named source asset for each category; source geometry metrics recorded.
validation_gates.editor_asset_gate: UE5.8 Editor import; per-LOD triangle/material-slot/collision checks; no placeholder JSON treated as a binary asset.
validation_gates.cook_gate: Android ASTC cook and iOS cook on supported x64 UE5.8 runners.
validation_gates.device_gate: Profile in fixed camera/movement captures on midrange Android Adreno and Mali plus supported iOS device; record GPU/Render/Game p50/p95/p99, draw calls, triangles, memory and thermal behavior.
validation_gates.performance_target: 60 FPS is the design target (16.67 ms frame budget), not a pass until physical-device captures meet the project gate.
validation_gates.gameplay_gate: Compare cover visibility, bridge traversability/nav, vehicle collision and replication across all quality tiers.
